space.expression: Polynomial working space for depth-first search; the ∏d_i output set need not all be retained.

notes: The post-reduction search cost is a tradeoff in the branching vector d. The Gaussian success formula is exact for continuous noise; transferring it to discrete LWE is an approximation. The original empirical BKZ seconds fit is not treated as an asymptotic bound.

extra.parameters: Fix n,q,m,s, reduced basis B and positive integer branching factors d_1,…,d_m.
extra.noise: Continuous Gaussian D_s with density proportional to exp(−π||e||²/s²); wide discrete Gaussian approximated by it.
extra.secret: General LWE secret; lattice target is As+e mod q.
extra.samples: m given LWE samples; no unlimited-sample substitution.
extra.objective: Recover the error and secret by lattice decoding.
extra.model: NearestPlanes visits ∏d_i leaves, each polynomial work; include basis reduction in total time.
extra.assumptions: Success probability formula uses independent Gaussian projections; basis-profile estimates can additionally use GSA.
extra.success: P = ∏_i erf(d_i ||b_i*||√π/(2s)); choose d to meet an explicit target P.
